source.title: Notice Regarding the Investment in Circle Internet Group, Inc.
source.issuer: SBI Holdings, Inc. and SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited
claims: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank invested USD 25 million each in Circle, USD 50 million combined, in connection with Circle's June 5, 2025 NYSE listing.
The same notice states that SBI Holdings invested in Ripple in 2016 and held approximately 9% of Ripple shares as its largest external shareholder as of the notice date.
The notice describes SBI's investment and partnership history across Ripple, R3/Corda and Securitize, reinforcing a multi-partner strategy rather than an exclusive single-ledger strategy.

interpretation.confirmed: As of June 9, 2025, SBI Holdings reported approximately 9% Ripple equity ownership while also committing USD 25 million to Circle; SBI Shinsei Bank separately committed USD 25 million to Circle.
interpretation.inference: SBI's disclosed portfolio shows parallel strategic exposure to Ripple and Circle, consistent with a multi-rail digital-finance strategy.
interpretation.not_established: Current 2026 Ripple share percentage, XRP token holdings, actual remittance volumes, or any plan to replace XRPL with Circle Arc.

next_actions: Use June 9, 2025 as the latest official SBI Ripple equity percentage disclosure found, not February 7, 2025.

Keep Ripple equity, XRP token inventory, and SBI Group stablecoin/Arc participation as separate graph edges.
